title: I added a clip generator to my mobile game, now marketing is slightly easier
author: Short_Stable2397
selftext:
My game DooDoo Snake has been live on the Play Store for just over a month now but marketing it has been... painful. I hate making and editing videos even though I play the game everyday so theoretically I generate a lot of content.

The other day I thought it would be a lot easier if I could share from my phone directly. One question to Claude and bam it wrote a plugin to render the video into the game's cache directory and showed the share screen. It took a few iterations to get the rendering time down and tbh I still don't know how it performs on devices with worse specs. 

The output is now attached to this post and I literally will never miss a juicy run just because I forgot to record it. My posting rate on tiktok has tripled as a result and so have the views. It has yet to bring me new players but I'm still stoked about this feature.

The caveat is that rendering times can get very long, ideally clips should be sub 2-3mins. I think that's more than enough content for shorts especially. Next iteration could be to somehow determine the 'highlights' reel and share that instead.

Cheers.
